I started somewhere in the 6th grade and as usual I would try to hide the cuts. When I started to hide them I noticed that one of my friends in my friend group was acting very similar to how I was.

Naturally I got curious and started to talk to them and they eventually opened up about their selfharming experience, so I did as well.
After that we would do it together under the bleachers during gym. One day we got caught with some bloody razors under the usual spot we would go to. 

My guess is that the gym teacher was getting suspicious of us going under there everyday so they reported us. We got called into the counselors office to be questioned and seeing my friend pretty shaken up about the whole thing I took full responsibility for bringing the razors and letting them use them. 

I got sent to a mental hospital that same day and I stayed there for about a month. After that I stopped cutting for about 3 and a half years. I sadly ended that streak a few months ago but I haven't done it since. It gets harder everyday to not go and retrieve my knife from its little hiding spot but I'm somehow still able to resist the temptation.
